STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE JUDGE PRO TEM MARK SCHREIBER FILED BY BOIKANYO, MANTSHA BURLEY, HOWCRIO

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-31-2009 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-31-2009 BY JUDGE PRO TEM: MARK SCHREIBER, CLERK: MARJORIE SCHWARTZ-SCOTT, NOT REPORTED (506) APPEARANCE BY BOTH SIDES. EXHIBITS RETAINED BY BOTH SIDES.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-31-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BOIKANYO, MANTSHA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BURLEY, HOWCRIO $50.00 PRINCIPAL, $30.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $80.00, THE COURT FINDS DEFENDANT INTENTIONALLY INTERFERED WITH PLAINTIFF'S POSSESSION OF THE ITEMS IN THE CLOSET; THE COURT FINDS FURTHER THAT THE DAMAGES REASONABLY ATTRIBUTABLE TO DEFENDANT'S ACTIONS TO BE $50.00, GIVEN THE LIMITED TIME PERIOD INVOLVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
